final: SELECT account_id, town_city, group_count, count_share, group_count / average_count AS count_to_average FROM (SELECT account_id, town_city, group_count, count_share, AVG(group_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM (SELECT g.account_id, g.town_city, g.group_count, 1.0 * g.group_count / t.town_total AS count_share FROM (SELECT f.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM Financial_Transactions AS f JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = f.account_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY f.account_id, c.town_city) AS g JOIN (SELECT town_city, SUM(group_count) AS town_total FROM (SELECT f.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM Financial_Transactions AS f JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = f.account_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY f.account_id, c.town_city) GROUP BY town_city) AS t ON CAST(g.town_city AS TEXT) = CAST(t.town_city AS TEXT))) ORDER BY count_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
